purpose: Teach: スニーカー/きゅうり/太く/ねじ/子守/鈍感/包む/乗り場

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、本気で、絶対、スニーカー、絶対、お父さん、絶対、孫に、絶対、買ってあげたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, when you were young — do you remember when your father bought you those sneakers? I really do.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Voice carries the weight of old memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. Lands gently on the final affirmation, as if confirming something precious to himself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。お庭で、本気で、絶対、きゅうり、絶対、お祖父ちゃん、絶対、たくさん、絶対、育てたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. And in the garden — do you remember how grandfather and I grew all those cucumbers together, dear?
lines.style: Warm, immediate agreement. Voice brightens slightly at the memory. Gentle pacing, unhurried. Slight smile audible in the trailing question, intimate and present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、若い頃の、絶対、腕、絶対、もっと、絶対、太く、絶対、たくましかったぞ、ばあさん、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, Gran — your father's arms were so much stronger then. Do you remember? Really strong.
lines.style: Wistful admiration. Voice touches on the past with quiet reverence. Slows slightly on the physical memory, lingering. Ends with simple certainty, not questioning.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、家具の、絶対、ねじ、絶対、自分で、絶対、締めてくれていたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Your grandfather — he used to tighten all the furniture screws himself, remember? He always took care of those things, dear.
lines.style: Affirming, warm recollection. Voice carries quiet pride in the detail. Steady, unhurried pace. Lands on the practical gesture as if it meant something larger.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、本気で、絶対、ばあさん、絶対、孫の、絶対、子守、絶対、よくしてくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When we were young, Gran — you used to watch the grandchildren so well. I haven't forgotten that. Do you remember?
lines.style: Tender recognition. Voice softens on the gratitude. Moderate pace, intentional. Slight tremor of genuine appreciation at the memory, not sentimentality.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、若い頃から、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、鈍感、絶対、なところ、絶対、あったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: You know, you've been a little oblivious since back then, dear — do you remember? That's always been there.
lines.style: Playful teasing with underlying affection. Light, knowing tone. Quick pace with a slight tilt of humor. Not unkind — the comfort of long partnership speaking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、絶対、ばあさんが、絶対、お弁当、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、包む、絶対、姿、絶対、お父さん、絶対、忘れないぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Long ago, Gran — I still haven't forgotten the way you wrapped the lunch boxes so carefully. That image stays with me. Do you remember?
lines.style: Deep, reverent nostalgia. Voice becomes quieter, almost humble. Slow deliberate pacing. The ordinary gesture elevated by long memory and love.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔、本気で、絶対、バス、絶対、乗り場、絶対、お祖父ちゃんと、絶対、待ったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Long ago, we used to wait together at the bus stop, you and your grandfather, remember? I still see us there, dear.
lines.style: Soft, intimate recollection. Voice settles into the shared memory. Unhurried, present-tense quality despite the distance of time. Closes with quiet certainty.
